about: Contents of wormhole gas and ore sites (relic and data sites: see relicAbout), by the site name the scanner shows. contents: [typeID, units] per resource (gas: one cloud of each; ore: the site total at spawn). status: verified = contents from the EVE University site page, unit volumes match Fuzzworks' gas table and the SDE, and All-Out's gas guide confirms two clouds per site; approximate = EVE University only, which says ore amounts are approximate and change with the system class; unverified = no reliable figures, so no value is shown. priceAs: the item whose price values a type: ore is priced as its compressed form (1 ore unit compresses to 1 compressed unit: both have portion size 100 in the SDE, and the compressed item is 1/100 of the volume), since raw ore barely trades and miners sell it compressed. Read by app/js/fork/site-values.js.
kspaceAbout: K-space gas and ore and the wormhole ore additions (checked 2026-11-21, changes/2026-11-21-all-gas-ore-site-values): k-space gas sites (Mykoserocin and Cytoserocin nebulae) and ore sites by their scanner names, from EVE University's Gas cloud harvesting table (2026-11-08) and each site's own page; ore anomaly and signature contents from each site page, kept only when every ore row adds up (units x the SDE volume = the m3 the page lists). where: where the site spawns. note: shown in the tooltip. contents units [low, high]: the sources disagree, both are shown. Gas is priced as raw gas (it trades well; compressed gas is 1 unit for 1 unit but loses some on decompression). Ore variants are their own types (II/III/IV-Grade, the pre-November-2025 names map by EVE University's rename table and the SDE descriptions), each priced as its compressed form. status verified = Mykoserocin (gas table and site page agree, checked by players in 2025-2026); approximate = everything else; unverified = no usable figures, reason says why.
relicAbout: Relic and data sites (checked 2026-11-15). families: one row per scanner-name family '<prefix> <faction> <layout>'; the faction is one of factions (or the family's own factions). value model = expected salvage of a Ruined site: per container type, every item of the faction's salvage list drops with a chance and a uniform stack (relicModel.perContainer = chance x mean stack, in units per item), value = sum over items of units x ESI average_price, T2 units on the T2 type and T1 units on the T1 type. Leaves out BPCs, carbon and Spatial Attunement Units (no published rates) and assumes every can is hacked. range = static anecdotal ISK range per site, with its source and date. sites with blueLoot = Sleeper rat loot (combat, not hacking) at fixed NPC buy orders, from EVE University Template:Whisk. status unverified = no value shown, reason says why. exclude: names that never get a chip.

exclude.reason: Wormhole Unsecured data sites are left out on purpose (2026-11-15).

relicModel.sourceNote: EVE University 'Pirate relic site loot' (page last edited 2026-09-08), based on MacrophageNT's study on r/Eve (af7536, about January 2019)
relicModel.chancesNote: [drop chance per item per container, smallest stack, largest stack]; stacks are uniform, so expected units = chance x (min + max) / 2
relicModel.pairNote: [T2 typeID, T1 typeID]; the Serpentis Malfunctioning Shield Emitter is T1 only
relicModel.dominantNote: One item worth half or more of an estimate is named in the tooltip with the estimate without it; it is not capped (there is no sourced ceiling to cap it at).
